messages:
Maya (Eng Lead): two-hour heads-up — code freeze for v1.9.0 at 1712350476 (≈2h). If you need a late landing read the exception policy: post PR link + short risk + test plan + approver(s). We'll only accept critical bugfixes. Reopening merge window briefly for exception reviews. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam: I have a runtime patch that prevents OOM with long sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5123. Small diff, touches allocator in packages/kv. Risk: medium if it regresses allocation; test: repro + staging run. Can I get exception?

Olivia (Release Manager): Thanks Sam. Please paste the short test commands you used and confirm there are no schema changes. We need at least one code owner approval + QA signoff. Post the PR checklist here. :clipboard:

Sam: test command: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS="-k kv_long_sequences" pytest tests/kv/test_allocator.py::test_long_seq_alloc --durations=10` — repro fixed locally. No schema changes. PR description updated with benchmark numbers.

Tony: tagging runtime owners — this touches allocator code. Can you include 95th/99th latency and mem usage numbers from your perf run? If it's mem reduction ok, but watch for regresses under burst load. :eyes:

Sam: perf snippet pasted in PR: peak mem 1.1GB → 0.8GB on 10k tokens, p99 latency +2%. I ran burst test with 50 concurrent sessions, no OOMs in staging run.

Nisha (QA): I can run quick regression in staging now. If you can push a build to staging I can validate chat flows + kv stress in ~30m. Ping me when build is ready. :white_check_mark:

Leo: heads up — I'm doing the v1.9.0 version bump in `release/v1.9.0` branch. If this lands and also my bump lands we'll have to coordinate cherry-pick order. Prefer landing fixes before bump merge. Let's avoid conflicting changelog edits.

Sam: understood — if needed I'll open a patch branch off `release/v1.9.0` and cherry-pick after your bump — shouldn't be a blocker.

Maya (Eng Lead): Plan: Tony reviews + Nisha verifies in staging. If both green, Olivia and I will sign off and I'll merge exception. Reminder: update CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased — include one-liner and impact. Also add a short rollback note.

Release Bot: Branch protection will be enforced at freeze: 1712350476. Exception approvals must be posted in this thread and have explicit signoffs from @Maya (Eng Lead) and @Olivia (Release Manager). :lock:

Sam: tagging when staging build is up. Thanks everyone. :pray:

Olivia (Release Manager): Please post final approval comment in the PR like `release/exception-approved — Olivia` so automation picks it up.

Maya (Eng Lead): Final note — unless it's a user-facing production incident we won't allow optional enhancements. Keep it narrowly scoped. I'll check back in 40m. :clock3:
